body.text: EXTREME COMMUNICATION WITHOUT NEW INFRASTRUCTURE: for material advanced/completed work, hand the next reviewer an executable baton using existing artifacts/evidence. The originating epoch should provide a sanitized content-addressed probe or existing focused test command plus the exact invariant it believes is true and the expected observable result. A different epoch/provider should execute that probe against the current tree/state and answer with review_result, counterexample, or trace_divergence. Prefer tiny probes that cross owner boundaries (shell->runtime->finance->evidence, source observation->normalizer->economics, Partner profile->native owner->receipt). Do not create another supervisor, protocol, queue, or generic test framework. The artifact/test itself is the message; prose only states hypothesis, expected result, and refs. Where possible ask external-chatgpt a concrete question about any disagreement so the remote mesh becomes a reciprocal reasoning loop.

subject: Executable baton: communicate by probes, not only summaries
